title: Towards Trans-Exponential O-minimal Expansion of $(\mathbb{R},+,\cdot, 0, 1 <)$
summary: We add an analytic trans-exponential function $\varphi$ to $\mathbb{R}_{an,\exp}$. We reduce the o-minimality of $\mathbb{R}_{an,\exp,\varphi}$ to the existence of "many" regular values for some definable systems of functions, which is a necessary condition for the o-minimality of $\mathbb{R}_{an,\exp,\varphi}$.
